answer_1.quote: Chinese spelling error correction (CSC) can be formalized as the following task. Given a sequence of n characters (or words) the goal is to transform it into another sequence of characters Y = (y 1 , y 2 , • • • , y n ) with the same length, where the incorrect characters in X are replaced with the correct characters to obtain Y.

answer_2.quote: As evaluation measures, we utilized sentence-level accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score as in most of the previous work.
